name: Paul
description: Store and query Romain's structured personal facts, relationships, activities, agenda, mood and habits.

saveFact.description: Save one durable personal fact. Use this for identity, home, preference or other stable information.

saveRelationship.description: Save a relationship between two people, such as Coralie is Romain's partner.

recordActivity.description: MANDATORY for every completed personal action. Record one activity only. If the owner lists several completed actions, call this function once per distinct action so Paul can answer exact last-time and count questions. Resolve relative dates such as hier, aujourd'hui and demain in occurredAt. Do not use saveFact, Context or OWNER.md for activities.

createAgendaItem.description: Create a dated task, appointment, personal event or reminder. Keep the types distinct.

completeAgendaItem.description: Mark a task, reminder or other agenda item as completed using its id.

getProgram.description: Return the combined program for a date or period: tasks, appointments, events, reminders and activities.

dateExpression.description: today, tomorrow, Wednesday, 12/09/2026, this month, etc.

queryActivities.description: MANDATORY for questions about when a completed activity happened, the last time it happened, or activities during a date range. Use this instead of Structured Knowledge, Context Search or OWNER.md. For 'quand est-ce que j'ai nettoyé les toilettes pour la dernière fois ?', use dateExpression 'ce mois-ci' or another relevant past range and object 'toilettes'.

countActivities.description: MANDATORY for exact counts of completed activities. Query Paul's structured journal; never count from conversation text, Context files or OWNER.md.

recordMood.description: Record Romain's mood or emotional state for a date.

saveHabit.description: Create or update a personal habit and its optional schedule.

getContext.description: Return a compact summary of Paul's personal facts, relationships and current context. Use for broad questions such as 'qu'est-ce que tu sais sur moi ?'. Do not use this instead of queryActivities for exact activity/date questions.
